name: agent-conduct-guidance
description: Independent ambient conduct modules and scoped task-time procedures for Copilot CLI: charter-bounded useful autonomy, durable operator pre-clearance, maintenance standby, consented Windows elevation, multi-agent authority and custody, headless process hygiene, owner-stamped scratch space, and secret-pattern masking avoidance. Optional assignment prompt/contract authoring and inert model configuration do not impose a delegation strategy. Enforcement stays with existing owners; no grant broker, automatic tool approval, runtime or required companion plugin.
